info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Authorization API
info.description: The Card Authorization API enables businesses to securely authorize card transactions in real-time. By utilizing this API, merchants can verify card details and validate the authenticity of transactions, enhancing fraud prevention measures and improving customer trust. Common users of this API include e-commerce platforms, payment processors, and financial institutions looking to integrate card payment functionalities. With efficient handling of authorization requests, this API streamlines payment processes and supports a seamless customer experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific credit card authorization by providing the card ID. It is useful for checking the current status and other relevant details of the card authorization.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a card authorization process for the specified card. Ensure that all required parameters are included in the request to successfully complete the operation.

200.description: The request was successful and the card authorization details were retrieved.

RetrieveCardAuthorizationDetailsRequest.description: A JSON string that represents the request body for card authorization operations.

RetrieveCardAuthorizationDetailsResponse.title: Card Authorization Response

cardToken.description: A unique token representing the card involved in the transaction.

cardholderId.description: Identifier for the cardholder associated with the transaction.

merchantId.description: Identifier for the merchant processing the transaction.

transactionAmount.description: Details of the transaction amount including the amount value and currency.

merchantCategoryCode.description: The category code of the merchant related to the transaction.

authorizationType.description: Type of authorization for the transaction (e.g., standard, pre-authorization).

terminalEntryMode.description: Mode used to enter the card details at the terminal (e.g., swipe, chip, contactless).

threeDSecureResult.description: Result of the 3D Secure authentication process.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the transaction record.

version.description: Version of the schema being used.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the record was last updated.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the response.
